title: Interpreted MATLAB Function
text: (To be removed) Apply MATLAB function or expression to input, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Output signal type} sets the block output signal type; {MATLAB Function} sets the function, {Output dimensions} sets the dimensions of the block output signal, {Collapse 2-D results to 1-D} sets the output a 2-D array as a 1-D array and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.
